idle_side.prompt: Stands still in a relaxed pose; its body rises and falls very slightly and its tail sways a little. It stays in place, facing right.

walk_side.prompt: Walks in place on four legs: the legs step one after another, the body bobs gently and the tail sways. It stays in place, facing right.

run_side.prompt: Gallops in place with its head lowered and its horns pointing forward, legs moving fast. It stays in place, facing right.

eat_side.prompt: Lowers its head to the ground, eats the grass with a few bites, then lifts its head back up. It stays in place, facing right.
